about: Package REF6: the 100 reference players' decks (docs/balance/ref6/ladder-100.json) against every road fight of their map (tools/ref6/measure.js header). Win rates in %. Per fight: the players' mean, SD, p10 / p50 / p90 over the 100 decks, sdTrue / p10e / p90e with the game noise taken out, the Map reference (mapRef) and Reference-2 (ref2) over refGames games. Per map: strength = each deck's mean over the map's road fights (decks: player 1..100).
